snippet.title: FishOnMC - Minecraft Server Trailer
snippet.description:
FishOnMC is Minecraft's first-ever fishing simulator with the goal of making the best possible fishing experience within Minecraft.

Development started in Fall 2022. First launch Summer 2023. New revamped version December 2024.

Created by Zebra and the FishOnMC team :)

IP: play.fishonmc.net
Java 1.20.5+

Socials
Discord: https://discord.gg/bSVfC7ngZv
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fishonminecraft/ (@fishonminecraft)
Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@fishonminecraft (@fishonminecraft)
X/Twitter: https://x.com/FishOnMinecraft (@fishonminecraft)
